fields.label: Email Account
fields.description: Must read over IMAP with sync option ALL, so the mailbox is opened read-only and nothing gets marked as read

fields.label: Folders
fields.options:
All Folders
Gmail All Mail
Manual
fields.description: All Folders: Inbox and every user folder, without Spam, Sent, Drafts and Trash. Gmail All Mail: the one Gmail folder that holds every label. Manual: keep the folder list of the Email Account as it is

fields.label: Forward Mail Received After
fields.description: Set when the mailbox is added. Mail that was already in the mailbox is not read; only mail arriving later is forwarded

fields.label: Mail Checked On
fields.description: If the mail server renumbers a folder, mail that arrived since this day is read again; mail already received is not duplicated
